author: macro-strategist-cyrus-daruwalla
construction: richness_index = 100*exp(-0.25*EY_hist_zscore_expanding); EY_hist_zscore_expanding is the ALREADY-VALIDATED market_state.parquet column (W2_market_M1 card, PROMOTE-CANDIDATE). 0.25 is a shape-calibration constant chosen so +-2sigma EY z-scores land near Principal's illustrative 60-70/160+ bands -- NOT fit to forward returns.
robustness: sign and rough magnitude STABLE under drop-one for all 3 crisis eras (rho stays in -0.26 to -0.38 band; never flips sign, never collapses to ~0).
honesty_note: n=215 monthly obs, index-level, inherently low-power per firm low-t rule -- judged on economic logic + drop-one, NOT t/DSR. The return-level relationship is real and stable; the crash-risk-specific claims (worst-return-from-entry, peak-relative drawdown) are WEAK (rho~0 to +0.35, wrong/no sign) -- richness predicts DIRECTION of average forward return well but does NOT clearly flag the SIZE of the worst forward drawdown at 1Y horizon.
verdict: PARTIAL SUPPORT -- fwd-return direction robust; crash-magnitude claim not confirmed at 1Y.
